chunks.text: Purpose | Validate extraction of text, heading hierarchy, page provenance, and reading order. This fixture includes four heading levels, repeated running headers and footers, a table, a vector chart, hyperlinks, a footnote, lists, and a callout.

Purpose | Elements included | Section headings (levels 1-4), paragraphs, lists, a structured table, chart and caption, footnote reference and note, hyperlink, shaded callout, running header, footer, and page number.
1. Overview and Document Structure | This section introduces the synthetic report and its intended use in extraction testing.

1. Overview and Document Structure | 1.1 Processing Objectives | The parser should preserve text, hierarchy, page provenance, and reading order while distinguishing body content from repeated page furniture.

1. Overview and Document Structure | 1.1 Processing Objectives | 1.1.1 Element Classification | Classify paragraphs, headings, list items, tables, images, captions, links, and footnotes as distinct logical elements where supported.

1. Overview and Document Structure | 1.1 Processing Objectives | 1.1.1 Element Classification | 1.1.1.1 Provenance and Coordinates | Each detected element should retain its page number and, when available, a bounding box. This is a test requirement, not a guarantee of parser behavior.

1. Overview and Document Structure | 1.1 Processing Objectives | Key objectives | Preserve section hierarchy and heading text.

Detect headers and footers without duplicating them in body text.

Recover table cells and identify figures or chart regions.
1. Overview and Document Structure | 1.2 Example Footnote References | The reported metric is illustrative and should not be interpreted as a real performance result. 1
1. Overview and Document Structure | 1.3 Validation Callout | Callout: Compare extracted output with the source page. Successful conversion alone does not establish content completeness.

PDF Layout & Metadata Test Fixture | Synthetic two-page document for testing section hierarchy, furniture, tables, figures, links, and footnotes.

PDF Layout & Metadata Test Fixture | 3. Two-Column Layout Test | This page contains two aligned content blocks, followed by hyperlink and appendix tests.

3.1 Left Column ; 3.2 Right Column
The left column contains prose and a short list. Reading order should remain consistent with the intended layout. ; The right column contains a note that should not be merged into the left paragraph mid-sentence.
Left-column list ; Right-column note
1. Detect the column boundary 2. Preserve paragraph grouping 3. Avoid interleaving adjacent lines ; Note: this block is positioned beside the left column to test reading-order reconstruction.

PDF Layout & Metadata Test Fixture | 3. Two-Column Layout Test | 3.3 Hyperlink and Reference Test | Open the Reserve Bank of India website or visit https://example.org/docling-fixture for a visible URL test.

Appendix A - Expected Metadata Fields | A.1 Acceptance Checklist | Field ; Expected evidence ; Status
heading ; Four-level heading hierarchy ; Test
header/footer ; Repeated running text and page number ; Test
table ; Rows, columns, and header cells ; Test
image ; Vector chart region and caption ; Test
footnote ; Superscript reference and note text ; Test
hyperlink ; Clickable link and visible URL ; Test
Appendix A - Expected Metadata Fields | A.1.1 Pass Criteria | Verify hierarchy, page association, table structure, link targets, and separation of body content from page furniture.

Appendix A - Expected Metadata Fields | A.1.1.1 Failure Recording | Record missing, duplicated, misclassified, reordered, or corrupted content with the affected page number and source-page evidence.

End of fixture.
